verdict.rationale: Plaid is a hosted fintech API service. Whether its source is readable under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack shows a public GitHub client SDK (plaid-node) and a cloneable Quickstart app, but these are developer building blocks rather than the product's own source, and no evidence names an open license for anything.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
